$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_outdoor 0.1.0, registry/FS_outdoor/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_outdoor, by a validator that implements FS_outdoor and knows it (spec.md 1.2). The core members of an element (fallback, host, clearances, option, name, extras) are checked by Floorspec Core, so this schema only names them. Relations between members - a coping and its box, gates along a line, posts and a box - are checked by the invariants (spec.md chapter 5).
title: FS_outdoor 0.1.0
description: Outdoor rooms: pools and spas, fences and gates, pergolas, porches and shade sails, outdoor kitchens and fire features.

collections.description: Core 12.5: the extension's elements, by kind.

length.description: Core 2.1: a length, an integer of base units (1/1280 mm).

pool.title: Pool
pool.description: 2.2: a pool, a plunge pool or a spa: its box from the basin's floor to the coping's top, the coping's outer edge in plan.

coping.description: 2.2: the coping's width on every side of the basin; twice it less than the box's X and Y (FS-OUTD-2.2.1, an invariant). Default 384000 (300 mm).

waterLine.description: 2.2: the water's surface below the top of the coping; less than the box's Z (FS-OUTD-2.2.2, an invariant). Default 192000 (150 mm).

copingMaterial.description: 2.2: what the coping is made of. Absent: not stated.

interior.description: 2.2: the basin's finish. Absent: not stated.

heated.description: 2.2: whether its water is heated. Absent: not stated.

onSlope.description: 2.3: how it follows falling ground. Default racked.

postSize.description: 2.4: the width of a post, square; less than the box's X and Y (FS-OUTD-2.4.1, an invariant). Default 192000 (150 mm).

postSpacing.description: 2.4: the greatest distance between two posts' centres along a side; greater than postSize (FS-OUTD-2.4.2, an invariant). Default 3072000 (2,400 mm).
